United States Department of the Interior
OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY WASHINGTON, D.C. 20240
PEP ER-75/974
DEC 5 1975
Dear Mr. Plumb:
The Department of the Interior has received and reviewed the draft environmental statement for the Bad Creek Project (FPC No. 2740) as transmitted by your September 30, 1975, letter. We have the following comments arranged by areas of Departmental jurisdiction and expertise.
Fish and Wildlife Resources
In general the draft statement adequately addresses projectimpacts on fish and wildlife resources. However, there two major areas for which data are incomplete and which the statement fails to describe and evaluate. These are:
1. Project impact on the development of a two-story fishery in Lake Jocassee, and
2. Project impact on Howard Creek's trout fishery due to flow reductions in Bad Creek.
On October 8, 1974, this Department commented on the license application. We recommended that studies of these two potential adverse impacts be completed and mitigation plans be prepared to compensate for the anticipated losses. We further recommended that this work be completed within one year after license issuance.
Unfortunately the draft statement does not bring the reader up to date on these studies and does not give any indication of whether or not the recommended timeframe for completion will be met. Pages 3-19 through 3-20 attempt to list and analyze project impacts on the Lake Jocassee fishery. Three of the eight items are not impacts but merely statements of fact concerning the project. This would be a good place to insert a status report on the two-story fishery impact study.
See revised Sections 2.2.2.2, 3.2.2.3, and 4 and 9.
No comment required.
